ABSTRACT 
( 56 ) 
References Cited 
Systems and methods for chip cooling with near edge jets in 
a direct liquid cooled module are disclosed . One of the 
functions of a direct liquid cooled module is to provide 
cooling liquid to components located on a chip . Jet impinge 
ment directly onto the back side of a chip is one cooling 
method that can provide more efficient cooling . An orifice 
plate includes an array of small diameter holes that corre 
spond to high velocity jet locations and large diameter holes 
for the insertion of tubes to connect to lower pressure 
cavities .
